content.text:
The drawing shows a nitrogen with an H below it, bonded on each side to a CH2 group, and each CH2 is bonded to a phenyl ring (Ph). This is dibenzylamine.

Reading the connectivity: Ph–CH2–NH–CH2–Ph, with each Ph expanded to c1ccccc1. There are no wedges, hashes or charges, so no stereochemistry is needed.

SMILES: c1ccccc1CNCc1ccccc1
